sql: CREATE VIEW v_measurement AS SELECT a.uuid AS uuid_analysis, s.uuid AS uuid_sample, f.uuid AS uuid_feature, f."name" AS feature_name, a."value", CAST(main.timezone('Australia/Sydney', main.timezone('UTC', s.datetime)) AS DATE) AS date, s.datetime AS datetime, an."name" AS analyte_name, an.units AS analyte_units, f.site AS site, f.flow AS feature_flow, f.lon AS lon, f.lat AS lat, a.rl_low AS rl_low, a.rl_high AS rl_high, COALESCE((lm."method" IN ('field', 'EN67 - Client Supplied Data')), CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)) AS is_field, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.uuid, CAST(main.timezone('Australia/Sydney', main.timezone('UTC', s.datetime)) AS DATE), COALESCE(lm.uuid_analyte, ('analysis:' || a.uuid)) ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.preference, 500) ASC, COALESCE((lm."method" IN ('field', 'EN67 - Client Supplied Data')), CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)) DESC, COALESCE((lm.organisation = 'ALS'), CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)) DESC, s.uuid, a.uuid) AS preference_rank FROM analysis AS a INNER JOIN "sample" AS s ON ((a.uuid_sample = s.uuid)) INNER JOIN feature_alias AS fa ON ((fa.uuid = s.uuid_feature_alias)) INNER JOIN feature AS f ON ((fa.uuid_feature = f.uuid)) INNER JOIN lab_method AS lm ON ((a.uuid_lab = lm.uuid)) INNER JOIN analyte AS an ON ((lm.uuid_analyte = an.uuid));

CREATE VIEW v_measurement_epa AS SELECT a.uuid AS uuid_analysis, s.uuid AS uuid_sample, f.uuid AS uuid_feature, f."name" AS feature_name, a."value", CAST(main.timezone('Australia/Sydney', main.timezone('UTC', s.datetime)) AS DATE) AS date, s.datetime AS datetime, f.site AS site, f.flow AS feature_flow, f.lon AS lon, f.lat AS lat, fm."name" AS mask_name, COALESCE((lm."method" IN ('field', 'EN67 - Client Supplied Data')), CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)) AS is_field, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.uuid, CAST(main.timezone('Australia/Sydney', main.timezone('UTC', s.datetime)) AS DATE), COALESCE(lm.uuid_analyte, ('analysis:' || a.uuid)) ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.preference, 500) ASC, COALESCE((lm."method" IN ('field', 'EN67 - Client Supplied Data')), CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)) DESC, COALESCE((lm.organisation = 'ALS'), CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)) DESC, s.uuid, a.uuid) AS preference_rank FROM analysis AS a INNER JOIN "sample" AS s ON ((a.uuid_sample = s.uuid)) INNER JOIN feature_alias AS fa ON ((fa.uuid = s.uuid_feature_alias)) INNER JOIN feature AS f ON ((fa.uuid_feature = f.uuid)) LEFT JOIN lab_method AS lm ON ((a.uuid_lab = lm.uuid)) INNER JOIN feature_mask AS fm ON (((fm.uuid_feature = f.uuid) AND (upper(fm.variant) = 'EPA')));
